_comment: Real-chip cycle factors, the one copy. Read by tools/patchkit/pk_dsp_budget.py and packages/emulator/control/src/load.rs (embedded at build time). Derived from the public manuals' cycle tables and our own instruction counts, not from firmware bytes. dsp: real cycles per block / emulator busy instructions per block, stock firmware, held note (dn2-trig1-hold, dt2-sample-trig); nominal and high bound of the assumed latencies; stock_busy: DSP instructions per block of the stock firmware with no module (emulator count, 1.16 / 1.11; re-measure on 1.17 / 1.12); finding at the end of docs/findings/06-sharc-engine-and-startup.md, tools/sharc_dev/sharc_cpi (out/clock/sharc.json). cf: ColdFire busy CPI (non-idle instructions, zero wait states, Bcc/stall tables of the MCF5441x manual), nominal = median over the scenarios, high = accelerated jumps and calls at 3, RTS at 9, every taken Bcc at 8; section 'ColdFire instruction rate' of docs/findings/07-emulator.md, tools/coldfire/cf_cpi.py (out/clock/cpi.json, CPI-REPORT.md). The ColdFire core runs at core_hz = 264 MHz; the emulator's model clock is 132 M instructions per emulated second.
